parameters: \bWelcome to the Safari Zone!\nIs it your first time here?
\bWhen you enter the Safari Zone, you\nstart with 30 Safari Balls for\ncatching POKéMON.
\bThe Safari Game is over when you run\nout of Safari Balls, or when you've\nwalked 500 steps.
\bCome in and enjoy the Safari Zone!
\bExcuse me!\nYou seem to be without a Pokéblock Case.
\bYour Safari Game will be much more\nfruitful if you use Pokéblocks.
\bPlease come back with a Pokéblock Case.
\bYou may obtain a Pokéblock Case from\nthe Lilycove Contest Hall.
\G\bAll you can catch for just ¥500!\nWould you like to play a Safari Game?
\G\bWe'll let you know when your game\nis over.
\G\bSo, until then, enjoy yourself, please!\nOff you go on your wild excursion!
\rHere, you may witness many kinds of\nPOKéMON rarely seen in Hoenn.
\rAnd, you'll see them in their wild,\nuntamed state in natural habitats.
\rWhat's more, we've thrown open the\ngates to POKéMON Trainers.
\rCome in and enjoy the Safari Zone!
